name: Fault Test - Beam Span Exceeded
description: Beam span 7.2m without column -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Open plan living hall spanning 7.2 meters across without any central column support.

name: Fault Test - Steep Drainage Slope
description: Drainage slope 1:30 -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Plumbing contractor installed steep sewer line with 1:30 hydraulic gradient.

name: Fault Test - Narrow Elder Door
description: Door 750mm for elder -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Elder bedroom door reduced to 750mm to fit extra wardrobe space.

name: Fault Test - Front Setback Deficient
description: Front setback 2.0m instead of mandatory 3.0m -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Encroached forward towards the 30ft road, leaving only 2.0m front yard.

name: Fault Test - FSI Overbuild
description: Built-up 2100 sqft on 1200 sqft plot (FSI 1.75 > 1.5) -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Building massive 3 floors covering 2100 sqft built-up area on a 1200 sqft plot.

name: Fault Test - Unsafe Safety Factor
description: Structural safety factor 1.2 (<1.5 limit) -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Reduced structural concrete design safety factor to 1.2 to shave reinforcement rebar costs.

name: Fault Test - Illegal Toilet Under Stair
description: Toilet built under staircase -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Powder room toilet squeezed directly under the dogleg stair flight.

name: Fault Test - Electrical Crossing Water
description: Conduit crossing unshielded water line -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Direct intersection between 230V electrical conduit and CPVC fresh water line.

name: Fault Test - Weak Submersible Pump
description: Pump head 5m for G+1 house -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Fitted small 5m pump head to save electricity, unable to reach 10m roof tank.

name: Fault Test - Narrow Corridor Clearance
description: Corridor passage 700mm -> Judge must FAIL
prompt: Narrow hallway bottleneck of 700mm leading to the rear bedrooms.
